principle: Preserve capabilities and safeguards, not existing components or control placement.

entities.name: Project
entities.relationship: Contains teams, configured integrations, repository workspaces, and daemon state.
entities.primarySurface: Persistent project context; project inspector for connection and configuration facts.

capabilities.intent: Inspect project, configuration, and connection health
capabilities.guard: Distinguish configured facts from observed state; never show stale state as connected.

capabilities.intent: Navigate destinations, find commands, use history and keyboard navigation
capabilities.guard: Preserve route scope, focus return, browser history, and mobile access to the same destinations.

entities.name: Team
entities.relationship: Owns configured agent memberships and a checkout binding; scopes conversations and activity.
entities.primarySurface: Team directory and team workspace header, with Members, Terminals, Messages, and Attention views.

capabilities.intent: Create a named team with instruction paths
capabilities.guard: Validate name and instruction paths; preserve draft on failure.

capabilities.intent: Rename a team or edit its instructions
capabilities.guard: Show inherited versus authored values; saving configuration is not restarting agents.

capabilities.intent: Change team order
capabilities.guard: Keyboard-accessible move up/down; preserve expected order revision.

capabilities.intent: Delete a team
capabilities.guard: Show affected memberships, runs, and message history; do not conflate team deletion with deleting a Git checkout.

entities.name: Configured agent membership
entities.relationship: Belongs to a team; selects an integration, optional role, and instructions; has zero or more runs over time.
entities.primarySurface: All agents and team Members directories with one shared inspector.

capabilities.intent: Search, group, collapse groups, inspect identity and prompt composition, copy member ID, open team or terminal
capabilities.guard: Separate configured model/policy/workspace from last observed run facts; preserve long IDs and source provenance.

capabilities.intent: Add an agent with name, integration, optional role, and instruction paths
capabilities.guard: Membership creation is distinct from starting a process.

capabilities.intent: Rename or edit agent integration, role, and instructions
capabilities.guard: Inherited execution policy and model values are read-only unless the existing command supports editing them.

capabilities.intent: Reorder members or move an agent between teams
capabilities.guard: Moving requires stopped state; destination and order revision must be explicit; no drag-only behavior.

capabilities.intent: Remove an agent membership
capabilities.guard: Retain the existing confirmation and explain affected runs/deliveries; do not label this as provider removal.

entities.name: Agent run
entities.relationship: One generation of a configured agent process; owns runtime status, terminal binding, and recovery state.
entities.primarySurface: Agent inspector Session tab and team-scoped run actions.

capabilities.intent: Start an agent or all eligible team agents
capabilities.guard: Show running, starting, approval-required, denied, and failed outcomes separately; starting an existing run is not unconditional restart.

capabilities.intent: Stop one run or confirmed stop of all active team runs
capabilities.guard: Keep entity identity and scope visible; preserve individual versus team confirmation behavior.

capabilities.intent: Inspect setup changes, preview recovery, retry, or recover eligible runs
capabilities.guard: Preview before apply; preserve uncertain ownership and explicit force confirmation; show partial success and approval-required outcomes.

capabilities.intent: Inspect observed status, completion, failure, health, provider update, and restart advisories
capabilities.guard: A connected terminal is not evidence that an agent is healthy or has completed a task.

entities.name: Terminal view and input lease
entities.relationship: Observes a run; input control is a separate browser lease, not the run lifecycle.
entities.primarySurface: Unframed team terminal workspace with session strip and one active terminal toolbar.

capabilities.intent: Attach, observe connection/reconnect state, and fit the terminal
capabilities.guard: Reuse the proven terminal engine and protocol, not old chrome; do not lose terminal mounts on view changes.

capabilities.intent: Automatic or 1/2/3 columns, focus/restore, pin/unpin, copy member identity
capabilities.guard: Keep fixed responsive dimensions and visible active-agent identity; focus is not stop/hide process.

capabilities.intent: Take control, observe/release, type, paste, resize, handle automated-input suspension and clipboard requests
capabilities.guard: Require current controller lease and interactive state; retain clipboard consent and browser restrictions.

capabilities.intent: Find next, select all scrollback, clear selection, copy selection, read selection help, open links
capabilities.guard: Copy requires a selection; clear selection is not clear history; links and clipboard actions remain deliberate.

capabilities.intent: Read bounded live output and previous checkpoints
capabilities.guard: Mark historical output explicitly; never replay a checkpoint into the PTY.

entities.name: Ad-hoc console
entities.relationship: A separately owned console session; not an agent membership.
entities.primarySurface: Project console workspace using the same terminal tools.

capabilities.intent: Open and close an ad-hoc console
capabilities.guard: Do not conflate closing the console with merely leaving a screen; show session identity and ownership.

entities.name: Terminal checkpoint
entities.relationship: Read-only historical output for a specific run generation.
entities.primarySurface: Transcript History view; maintenance entry from System.

capabilities.intent: List and select historical output
capabilities.guard: Preserve generation, timestamp, truncation, and sensitivity metadata.

capabilities.intent: Delete a stored checkpoint
capabilities.guard: Deleting historical output is separate from the live terminal and run.

capabilities.intent: Capture a checkpoint explicitly
capabilities.guard: No current production UI caller found; do not claim this as an existing button.

entities.name: Team conversation and message
entities.relationship: Messages have audience, intent, delivery outcomes, and read state; prompting an agent is a separate action.
entities.primarySurface: Conversation list and timeline with an attached composer.

capabilities.intent: Read history, fetch older/newer pages, jump to latest, inspect delivery and unread state
capabilities.guard: Preserve read cursors, pinned scroll position, recipient outcomes, and failure navigation.

capabilities.intent: Send direct, multicast, or group messages with inform/request/response/control intent
capabilities.guard: Explicit recipient scope; multicast needs at least two; preserve byte limit, sender restrictions, and drafts on failure.

capabilities.intent: Clear stored team message history
capabilities.guard: Keep confirmation and explain history versus active run effects; not a per-message delete.

entities.name: Durable work item
entities.relationship: Tracks a prompt's execution independently of message delivery.
entities.primarySurface: Message execution details and Attention activity inspector.

capabilities.intent: Prompt when ready, separately from delivering the message
capabilities.guard: Keep execution opt-in and distinct from delivery acknowledgement; show partial failure.

capabilities.intent: Inspect durable actions, attempts, acknowledgements, and open waits
capabilities.guard: Preserve partial-loading errors and distinguish acknowledged, completed, failed, and unverified.

capabilities.intent: Cancel a durable action
capabilities.guard: No current production UI caller found.

entities.name: Attention item
entities.relationship: A projection pointing to another entity, not an independent source of agent truth.
entities.primarySurface: One inbox with optional team scope; selection opens an inspector beside the list.

capabilities.intent: Needs action/Active/History/All, search, type/team filters, selection, bulk selection, source navigation
capabilities.guard: Keep selected scope visible; preserve partial errors, empty results, and dismissal eligibility.

capabilities.intent: Dismiss eligible items individually or in bulk
capabilities.guard: Dismiss is not resolve, approve, answer, or acknowledge completion.

capabilities.intent: Submit a structured wait reply
capabilities.guard: Current UI routes to the terminal; expected run/generation/reporter/status are mandatory if exposed later.

capabilities.intent: Acknowledge agent completion explicitly
capabilities.guard: Current UI dismissal is not this operation.

entities.name: Agent attention subscription
entities.relationship: Per-member event preferences layered over repository and agent defaults.
entities.primarySurface: Agent inspector Attention tab, reachable from inbox and terminal bell.

capabilities.intent: Inspect nine event types, enable/disable each or all, and reset overrides
capabilities.guard: Keep inherited/config versus operator-override provenance; reset means inherit, not disable all.

capabilities.intent: Open/dismiss in-app notification and pause expiration on hover/focus
capabilities.guard: Toast dismissal is separate from durable inbox dismissal; honor subscribed events and current context.

entities.name: Custom-launch consent request
entities.relationship: Binds a decision to an exact launcher subject and configuration revision before a run starts.
entities.primarySurface: Attention inspector with an explicit command/permissions review step.

capabilities.intent: Inspect the exact launch request, command, paths, environment names, and permission floor
capabilities.guard: Never expose credentials or collapse review to a generic green button; distinguish pending/stale/denied/cancelled/approved.

capabilities.intent: Fetch a launch request individually
capabilities.guard: Current UI reads complete requests from the list; a separate endpoint is not a separate feature.

capabilities.intent: Trust and start; approve and retry applicable team recovery requests
capabilities.guard: Exact subject digest/config revision; approval and successful process start are different outcomes.

capabilities.intent: Cancel a pending launch request
capabilities.guard: Cancel stores no trust decision; it is not durable denial.

capabilities.intent: Durably deny the exact launcher
capabilities.guard: No current production UI caller found; the existing launch pane supports trust/start and cancellation, not a denial control.

capabilities.intent: Revoke a trust receipt
capabilities.guard: No current production UI caller found; revocation is distinct from cancelling a request.

entities.name: Browser URL request
entities.relationship: An expiring request from an identified run to open an HTTP(S) URL.
entities.primarySurface: Attention inspector showing origin, full URL, and requesting agent.

capabilities.intent: Inspect origin/full URL, revalidate freshness, explicitly open or dismiss
capabilities.guard: No auto-open; stale/expired requests and browser popup blocking remain visible; dismiss does not approve.

entities.name: Git checkout and team binding
entities.relationship: Belongs to a repository; a team can bind to it; a managed worktree additionally has provenance and lifecycle.
entities.primarySurface: Branch directory with inspector tabs for Assignment, Changes, and Maintenance.

capabilities.intent: Inspect checkout status, references, primary/linked/managed identity, and team bindings
capabilities.guard: Primary, linked, and Nanasa-managed are not interchangeable; refresh is not fetch.

capabilities.intent: Fetch updates and refresh projected statuses
capabilities.guard: Network fetch remains deliberate; never perform it just by opening a form.

capabilities.intent: Create a branch worktree from a revision, optionally assign and activate
capabilities.guard: Preserve branch/base, unassigned default, activation opt-in, and configuration versus runtime binding distinction.

capabilities.intent: Attach an existing checkout by path
capabilities.guard: Existing path is not a new worktree; preserve assignment and activation choices.

capabilities.intent: Bind a team to a checkout, with an explicit active-run transition policy
capabilities.guard: Revision checks; stopped-only, stop-and-switch, or stop-switch-restart; show per-member outcomes.

capabilities.intent: Remove a managed worktree when eligible
capabilities.guard: Preserve primary/external/dirty/assigned/running protections and expected operation generation; never implement arbitrary folder deletion.

entities.name: Provider extension and configured integration
entities.relationship: An extension supplies provider capabilities; an integration selects command, credentials, model, execution policy, and recovery used by agents.
entities.primarySurface: Provider directory and read-only integration inspector, with a separate plan-review mode for maintenance.

capabilities.intent: Inspect installed/catalog state, integration use, health, drift, version, permissions, owned mutations, and command preview
capabilities.guard: Configured integration is not extension package state; no unsupported OAuth/login or arbitrary integration editor.

capabilities.intent: Approve an exact provider change plan
capabilities.guard: Package/plan digest, permissions, mutations, affected agents, and stopped-run requirements remain visible.

capabilities.intent: Install, repair owned state, disable, or roll back
capabilities.guard: Distinct lifecycle verbs and trust requirements; no generic Update button that hides actual effects.

capabilities.intent: Remove an extension from Nanasa
capabilities.guard: Retain exact extension-ID confirmation and clarify retained auth/session/provider data.

capabilities.intent: Fetch separate plan or health endpoints
capabilities.guard: Current inspection already supplies the displayed plan and health; do not duplicate commands to match API count.

entities.name: Provider state binding
entities.relationship: Managed state with credential reference and retention lifecycle, distinct from the installed extension.
entities.primarySurface: Provider inspector State view, with System diagnostics as another entry point.

capabilities.intent: Inspect, retain, or delete provider state
capabilities.guard: State retention/deletion is not package uninstall or credential editing; preserve lifecycle and storage reference.

entities.name: Role presentation
entities.relationship: Shared visual identity applied to configured roles; does not change the role's permission policy.
entities.primarySurface: Preferences Roles view and role link in agent inspector.

capabilities.intent: Choose a supported glyph, color, and compact name
capabilities.guard: Supported enum values only; real swatches and glyphs with names; presentation never grants permissions.

entities.name: Daemon service and remote connection
entities.relationship: Hosts coordination; process continuity and SSH forwarding are separate from team execution.
entities.primarySurface: System hub with Health, Service, and Remote views; connection indicator links to the same facts.

capabilities.intent: Inspect service lifecycle and preview planned reconnect behavior
capabilities.guard: Current action previews a restart; do not invent a restart execution button; tmux process continuity differs from WebSocket reconnect.

capabilities.intent: Inspect loopback endpoints, SSH/authentication boundary, and recovery guidance
capabilities.guard: No browser-managed tunnel, public exposure, or multi-user hosting controls are currently supported.

capabilities.intent: Read offline help, discover shortcuts, inspect build identity, and copy diagnostics
capabilities.guard: Preserve actual product/build compatibility and offline access; fixture versions must not imply installed truth.

entities.name: Browser preferences
entities.relationship: Browser-owned presentation and notifications, not daemon configuration.
entities.primarySurface: Preferences with Appearance, Accessibility, Notifications, and Roles views.

capabilities.intent: System/light/dark, comfortable/compact, system/reduced/full motion, system/forced/standard contrast
capabilities.guard: Preserve system-following choices, cross-tab persistence, and focus/reduced-motion behavior.

capabilities.intent: Enable sound, request/disable desktop notifications, send a test
capabilities.guard: OS permission is not a fake switch; show unsupported, denied, permission-required, and granted states.
